description: Use the released organization preset while retaining development-container coverage.

packageRules.description: Coordinate verifier workflow and hallway image proposals; the engineering lead generates locked evidence before merge.
prBodyNotes: Completion required for workflow-only, image-only, digest-only and grouped updates. Select one published capability-verifier vX.Y.Z release, then run `python3 tools/update_verifier.py --tag vX.Y.Z` on this branch. It coordinates workflow SHA, devcontainer digest, README example and all four locks through `python3 tools/lock.py --update` logic and checks that the tag uniquely identifies the verifier commit; evaluator follows only that release declaration, robot/reporter pins stay unchanged. Hosted Mend Renovate cannot execute our lock generator; grouping does not guarantee matching releases. Review the generated diff, commit with a `fix:` or `chore:` prefix, and require exact-head fresh-resolution checks and all four configuration pipelines. The engineering lead may merge once those required checks pass on the exact head SHA and verification evidence is recorded. A human approval is not a merge gate. See README.md, Updating the verifier. Never hand-edit hashes or bypass a failing guard.
